name: objection_resolved_drops_mode
description: Caller raises a price objection, agent rebuts, caller says 'fair enough, makes sense'. The FSM must enter objection_handling on the objection turn and exit on the acceptance turn.

turns.text: We have Skyline Heights with 3 and 4 BHK apartments starting at ₹2.45 crore.
That's too expensive for me honestly.
I understand. We have payment plans starting at ₹52k/month EMI and the price includes premium amenities and parking. The location is appreciating fast — a one-time investment for long-term gains.
